articles.title: ‘Films Are Like Dreams and Magic Tricks’: A Conversation with Mike Mills
articles.summary: The article introduces Mike Mills, detailing his creative upbringing in 1970s-80s Southern California. His childhood, immersed in skateboarding, punk rock, and art school, cultivated a distinct, unconventional personality. By the mid-1990s, he was embarking on a professional career, with these formative experiences evidently shaping his journey as a significant figure in creative fields.

articles.title: Quote of the Day by Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam: 'Excellence is a continuous process and not...'-Inspiring life lessons on excellence, hard work, and continuous growth by the aerospace scientist known as the 'Missile Man of India'
articles.summary: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam's 'Quote of the Day' defines true excellence as more than just a destination like success. He stresses it's built daily through persistent effort, rigorous discipline, and unwavering commitment. This philosophy is crucial for SSB aspirants, encouraging them to embrace continuous hard work and perseverance as key to achieving personal growth and leadership qualities.

articles.title: Tonk police bust interstate crude oil theft gang, 12 held
articles.summary: Tonk police successfully busted an interstate crude oil theft gang, arresting 12 individuals. This major law enforcement operation highlights ongoing efforts against organized crime impacting national resources. Concurrently, Assam observed Kargil Diwas, honouring the 1999 war martyrs, reinforcing national pride and gratitude for the armed forces' profound sacrifices.

articles.title: Exclusive - Juhi Mui actor Vijayendra Kumeria on his criteria for picking new roles: 'I don't enjoy repeating myself'
articles.summary: Actor Vijayendra Kumeria recently discussed his approach to selecting new roles, stating a clear preference for diversity and avoiding repetitive characters. In an exclusive interview, he articulated a professional criterion focused on seeking fresh challenges and different storylines, rather than revisiting similar roles. This reflects an artist's commitment to growth within the entertainment industry.

articles.title: Retired govt employee duped of Rs 16.54 lakh in senior citizen card scam
articles.summary: Assam commemorated Kargil Diwas, honouring 1999 war martyrs and their supreme sacrifice, a poignant national tribute reinforcing the valour of India's armed forces. Meanwhile, a Tripura Congress MLA sought a judicial inquiry into DGP Anurag Dhankar's death, questioning the government's internal probe and demanding transparency.

articles.title: Sahibganj govt ANM training centre lies shut for 15 years despite Rs 2.08 crore investment
articles.summary: Assam recently honoured the 1999 war martyrs on Kargil Diwas, commemorating their supreme sacrifice and bravery during the conflict. This annual observance serves as a powerful reminder of the nation's gratitude towards its defence forces. Such events reinforce patriotism and inspire future generations, especially SSB aspirants, towards dedicated national service and understanding military history.

articles.title: Weekly current affairs: Dharmendra Pradhan quits amid CJP protest, DRDO milestones, Commonwealth Games and more
articles.summary: This weekly current affairs update covers significant national and international events. Key topics include Union Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation amidst a CJP protest, notable milestones achieved by DRDO, highlighting advancements in defence technology, and updates from the Commonwealth Games. Aspirants should follow these developments for their SSB preparation.

articles.title: Op Sindoor is proof of India's capability to respond decisively to Pakistan's every misadventure: Raksha Mantri in Dras on 27th Kargil Vijay Diwas
articles.summary: India's Ministry of Defence declared that any future talks with Pakistan would exclusively center on Pakistan-occupied Kashmir (PoK), reiterating its status as an integral Indian territory. This strong stance contrasts India's commitment to progress and innovation with Pakistan's promotion of terrorism, highlighting a firm diplomatic and security position on a critical bilateral issue.

articles.title: Reports by fleet commanders on the security landscape and current missions
articles.summary: On Russia's Navy Day, the Supreme Commander-in-Chief received comprehensive reports from the commanders of its Pacific, Northern, Baltic, Black Sea fleets, and the Caspian Flotilla. These briefings covered critical security aspects and operational readiness across Russia's extensive maritime domains. This event highlights Russia's strategic emphasis on naval power projection and defence capabilities, essential for safeguarding national interests and maintaining regional stability.

articles.title: Russia Сreates Its First Unmanned Naval Systems Regiment
articles.summary: The Russian Navy is significantly expanding its unmanned surface and underwater vehicle capabilities. Its Northern Fleet already operates a dedicated regiment for these advanced autonomous systems. Plans are actively underway to establish a similar specialized unit within the Pacific Fleet next year, indicating a strategic modernization and integration of unmanned naval warfare technologies across Russia's key naval forces for enhanced operational reach.

articles.title: Any talks with Pakistan would focus solely on PoK, an integral part of India: Rajnath
articles.summary: India's Defence Minister has firmly stated that any future talks with Islamabad will be solely conditional on India's take over of Pakistan Occupied Kashmir (PoK). Reaffirming PoK as an integral part of India, the Minister's declaration on Sunday underscores a strong national stance. This significant statement, made during the 27th Kargil Vijay Diwas commemoration, highlights India's unwavering position on the disputed territory.

articles.title: mcgram added to PyPI
articles.summary: mcgram is a tool enabling the AI 'Claude' to notify users about long-running tasks via Telegram or ntfy.sh. Users can receive notifications and even respond back through Telegram, facilitating communication and efficient management of prolonged AI processes, allowing users to disengage from constant monitoring.

articles.title: Can Neeraj Chopra beat Arshad Nadeem at CWG 2026?
articles.summary: India's Olympic medallist Neeraj Chopra is set to compete at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow. He faces a formidable challenge on the athletics stage, notably from Pakistan's reigning Olympic champion, Arshad Nadeem. This highly anticipated international showdown will see Chopra aiming to secure another major medal, generating significant national interest and excitement for the event.

articles.title: China built full-size models of US warships and aircraft to hone its missiles
articles.summary: China has constructed extensive replicas at remote sites, enabling its troops and engineers to conduct realistic training simulations for potential attacks against Taiwan and the US military. This development highlights China's strategic intent to enhance its operational capabilities and preparedness for future regional contingencies, underscoring evolving geopolitical tensions and defence readiness efforts.
